workload.controlRestoration: restore initial fake configurations with independent bounded context
workload.costLabel: synthetic/estimated microUSD; not bills or real savings

knownLimits: Loopback synthetic four-chunk workload; not a production capacity estimate.
No profiling or limiter attribution: descriptive timings only, no speedup or winner claim.
Client and server share host resources; OS scheduling and other activity can affect results.
External mode mutates demo controls and requires exclusive access, primary/backup routing, threshold 3, matching timeouts and demo/rate/budget keys.
Throughput uses verified completions divided by phase wall time; failed requests remain in raw observations and failure counts.
Outage elapsed includes the circuit snapshot after three sequential threshold requests; at least three outage requests run per round.
HTTP response bytes exclude headers and framing; TTFT starts before sending request and ends at first nonempty delta.
